exposure: Day of the week of infant's birth
outcome: Timely receipt of birth dose of Hepatitis B vaccine
cohort: 409 infants born to pregnant women with and without HIV
finding: Only the day of the week of infant's birth was significantly associated with timely receipt of HBV vaccine, with lower odds for infants born on weekends.
mod_finding: No association was found between mode of delivery and infant receipt of a timely birth dose of HBV vaccine.
